# RFR Real Estate

> RFR Real Estate & Advisory FZ-LLC is a brokerage and advisory firm that works only in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE. The practice concentrates on Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village and Downtown RAK. Clients buy, sell, lease and manage homes, including off-plan launches on Al Marjan Island.

The firm is licensed in Ras Al Khaimah. It does not publish a street address. Contact is by phone, WhatsApp or email.

- Phone: +971 58 501 5885
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/971585015885
- Email: info@rfrrealestate.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday 9:00–18:00, Saturday 10:00–16:00 (Gulf Standard Time)
- Areas: Al Marjan Island, Mina Al Arab, Al Hamra Village, Downtown RAK
- Services: sales, leasing, property management, investment consultation, off-plan launches

## Areas

- [Al Marjan Island](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/al-marjan-island): Four coral-shaped islands and the new resorts. A group of man-made islands off the Al Hamra coast. Most of RAK’s branded residences are being built here, including Address, Nobu, JW Marriott, Nikki Beach and W, and the Wynn resort is due to open in 2027.
- [Mina Al Arab](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/mina-al-arab): Lagoons, mangroves and the quiet side of the coast. A low-rise waterfront community built around lagoons and protected mangroves, anchored by the Anantara and InterContinental resorts. Villas, townhouses and lagoon-front apartments in an established, family-led neighbourhood.
- [Al Hamra Village](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/al-hamra-village): Golf, marina and the deepest rental market in RAK. The Emirate’s original master community: an 18-hole championship golf course, a marina and yacht club, the Waldorf Astoria, a mall and a decade of tenants. Falcon Island, its private villa enclave, sits within it.
- [Downtown RAK](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/areas/downtown-rak): The working city: corniche, hospitals, offices. Al Nakheel, Julphar and the corniche, where the Emirate actually works. Towers and mid-rise apartments with the highest yields and the shortest commutes to RAKEZ, the hospitals and government.

## Off-plan launches

- [Address Residences](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/address): Emaar, Al Marjan Island, from AED 2,400,000, handover Q1 2028, plan 80 / 20. Emaar’s first RAK branded residences. Hotel-serviced, beachfront.
- [Nobu Residences](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/nobu): H&H Development, Al Marjan Island, from AED 2,100,000, handover Q1 2028, plan 60 / 40. Nobu hotel, restaurant and residences on one plot. Owner privileges across Nobu worldwide.
- [JW Marriott Residences](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/jw): WOW Resorts, Al Marjan Island, from AED 2,950,000, handover Q4 2027, plan 60 / 40. Curved twin towers with Marriott management, plus a rental pool for owners who live abroad.
- [Nikki Beach Residences](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/nikki): Aldar, Al Marjan Island, from AED 1,750,000, handover Q4 2028, plan 60 / 40. Beach-club brand with Aldar’s balance sheet behind it.
- [W Hotel & Residences](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/w): Dalands, Al Marjan Island, from AED 4,060,000, handover Dec 2027, plan 50 / 50. Marriott’s W brand. The highest entry price on the island, and the most hotel-led.
- [Costa Mare](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/costa): Ellington, Al Marjan Island, from AED 2,100,000, handover Q3 2028, plan 70 / 30. Design-led Dubai developer, four towers on the southern beach.
- [Manta Bay](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/manta): Major Developers, Al Marjan Island, from AED 1,200,000, handover Q4 2026, plan 50 / 50. Earliest handover in this wave, so you can let it before Wynn opens.
- [Sora Beach Residences](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/sora): AARK, Al Marjan Island, from AED 2,800,000, handover Q4 2026, plan 60 / 40. Low-density beachfront with larger floor plates.
- [Masa Residence](https://www.rfrrealestate.com/off-plan/masa): Durar Group, Al Marjan Island, from AED 920,000, handover Q4 2026, plan 60 / 40. The entry ticket to the island.
